spans.text: Elsa jumps down and hastily runs after the Saint.
The refugees cheer and surge toward the dining hall.
Once I'm certain nobody is looking, I slip off to the appointed location and activate my micro communicator.
Is everyone in position?
Is everything okay, Commander?
It's been a while, Commander. I almost thought you'd fallen in love with the lifestyle here.
...Things are fine on my end.
How about you? Keep it brief.
In keeping with the plan, we've infiltrated the village through the lightly-guarded side gates and taken the high ground. Now we're standing by for further instructions.
Commander, the number of Paradeus units in the village today has increased. Would you like to bring forward your withdrawal time?
Relax, everything is going as planned.
I'm in position too. I've blended in with the other rich patrons and successfully entered the wealthy quarantine zone of Bohnsdorf.
By the way, Commander, this is a "fake refugee village".
What do you mean, "fake"?
I can see everything you're doing from there. It's like a circus.
All the forbidden areas in Bohnsdorf are fitted with one-way mirrors and cameras. These wealthy people have come here to secretly observe them.
...Say what?
Also, I didn't spot anyone suspicious on the list of wealthy people that Elia provided.
We didn't find anyone suspicious either.
...So there's nobody suspicious in the village. Looks like the past few days were a bust.
Oh yes, do you know anything about that Saint?
I saw her heading to the temporary first-aid station in the north.
Dandelion, why is it so noisy on your side? Have you been noticed?
The "Saint"? What an interesting entity.
The wealthy people here started howling like wild animals the moment she appeared. They were bidding high prices to receive her private attentions.
Dandelion presses her communicator to the slit of the door, and I can hear terrifying cries coming through it.
Move it away. I'll have nightmares if I keep listening to it.
In any case, that's how things are over here.
Commander, are you going to investigate this Saint?
Well, I can't just leave empty-handed.
I'll try and make contact with this Saint afterwards. Judging by Elsa's reaction, she seems to have the utmost faith in her.
Understood. We can move ahead of schedule if anything unusual happens.
I need to go. They'll get suspicious if I'm gone for too long.
I'll look into the Saint. We'll meet at the rendezvous point when it's time.
Roger!
I follow the information the AR Team has provided me and find the Saint's trail.
...Your faith must be mighty indeed to heal so many people.
Faith? I don't have anything that profound.
I simply wish to heal as many ELID patients as I can. That is my mission.
Giving of yourself to cleanse the world is the holy purpose of a saint.
Surely you will not shun other forms of self-sacrifice, no?
Everyone here will gladly sacrifice themselves if it will make the world a better place.
I doubt that.
But I myself...have no such reservations.
I knew you would understand.
Ah, we're here. In here, please.
The door to Elia's room slowly opens, and the two head inside.
Elia's room is much larger than the refugee aid stations, and many people are already waiting inside...
This doesn't look like a treatment room...
Ah—
A squeal comes from inside the room.
There's no time to think. I rush over to the door to see what's going on.
Through the gap, the furious flurry of discharging flashbulbs very nearly blinds me.
No! This isn't a ward for the ill!
My Lady! Take a picture with me!
My Lady, please autograph my body! Anywhere will do!
There's...There's too many people... Please... Let me go!
The Saint is driven into a corner by the ardent throng, and she nervously clutches at Elia.
Elia, save me...
My Lady, this is one of the ways to make Bohnsdorf a better place.
You've devoted much of yourself to cure ELID infections before. This is simply another way of doing that...
Elia ignores the Saint's fear. She shrugs off the hand grasping at her and walks into the crowd indifferently.
Noooo! Let me go!
I don't want to be here! Please, somebody... Anybody, please take me away! I don't want to be here!
You really are a saint. Even the way you beg is so...exciting.
Elia's departure makes the wealthy people in the room even more lascivious.
They clutch their cameras, their video recorders, their autograph books...and shove them up into the Saint's face.
Save me... Please save me...
I don't know if it's because of my anger or the Saint's helplessness, but I can feel the door trembling.
No, I don't want to be here...
Her wail of despair seems to resonate in my chest...
My hand moves of its own accord to the door. I can save her if I can just get rid of this annoying lock.
Anger courses through my arms and I end up ripping the door off its hinges with my bare hands.
With the door now out of the way, I ignore the galaxy of flashlamps discharging in the distance and zero in on the frail white figure tumbling backward into my arms.
Come with me!
Come with me if you want to leave.
Robin! What are you doing?!
Get out! You shouldn't be here!
The Saint offers me a trembling hand.
Before anyone else can react, I grab it and run...
Angry shouts come from behind me.
Quick, stop them! Have the entertainment Dolls block them!
Elia, you'd better think of something or else your future sponsorship—
Stop them!!!
RO! Dandelion!
My cover's been blown! I need backup ASAP!
Roger! Heading over now!!
While I can understand your sloppy work is due to having never done this before, only you could so brazenly abduct someone in broad daylight.
Stop making jokes at my expense and think of a way to hold them back!
I've hacked into the entertainment Dolls, they should be able to stop some of your pursuers.
Follow this road to the village entrance. RO will meet you there and I'll catch up shortly after.
The voices behind me gradually fade into the distance as we sprint down the road leading to the entrance.
...Robin, is that your name?
No, but you can call me that for now.
My...My name is Machlian...
A few villagers suddenly burst out from a fork in the road, and Elia's voice grows louder.
Robin is kidnapping the Saint!!
Everyone, stop them!!
Dandelion!
Please hold.
A group of entertainment Dolls emerge from parts unknown and begin grappling with the villagers.
However, most of the villagers are still in pursuit.
My Lady!
Robin, what are you doing?!
That's our Saint, how could you—
Elsa...
Elsa is part of the crowd. Her eyes fill with tears as she gapes at me in disbelief.
There's no time for me to explain. All I can do is drag Machlian to the meeting point.
Robin is a traitor!
A traitor and a heretic! Stop them!
